title: Soleil at Seagrove
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘‘Soleil” a Gulf Front Estate with 6 Bedroom, 6.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers 2 private pools, Deeded Beach Access views, bikes & 6-seater golf cart.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Gulf Front Gated Private Estate • Gulf Front Infinity Edge Pool • Deeded Beach Access with complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 • Pool House with Secondary Pool (pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) • Elevator • Carriage House • 6-Seater Golf Cart Included • 6 Bikes Included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 18) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 4) • Bedroom 1: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities & Walk-in Tile Shower • Bedroom 2: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR (Sleeps 10) • Bedroom 3: Primary Guest Suite (sleeps 2): King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Contemporary Walk-in Shower + Dressing Area • Bedroom 4: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower w/ Bunk Area(sleeps 6) Two Full over Full Bunks & one Twin over Twin Bunk CARRIAGE HOUSE (Sleeps 2) • Bedroom 5: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower POOL HOUSE (Sleeps 2) • Queen Sleeper Sofa (sleeps 2) with Private entrance to Shared Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower DESCRIPTION: This coastal estate is more than a home, it’s a masterpiece of elegance, perfectly tailored for hosting unforgettable moments. Step into the grand entry foyer on the first level, where a spiral staircase and custom chandelier set the tone for the opulence within. A wraparound glass elevator provides a seamless transition between floors, while two guest suites offer private sanctuaries. Guests can retreat to a cozy living area, complete with a full bath, laundry room, and climate-controlled storage for added convenience. Just outside, an enchanting, covered patio leads to a raised boardwalk and dune walkover, placing you mere footsteps from Seagrove Beach's sugar-white sands and azure waters. The second floor serves as the heart of the home, designed for relaxation and entertaining. A culinary kitchen, outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances and exquisite finishes, anchors the space. The modern living room seamlessly opens to the infinity pool deck, where breathtaking Gulf views provide a stunning backdrop. A dining room, also showcasing panoramic coastal vistas, is perfect for hosting memorable meals. Additional features on this floor include a wet bar, a charming library nook for quiet retreats, and a north-facing balcony that doubles as a summer kitchen, ideal for al fresco dining and sunset gatherings. The third floor is a splendid retreat, featuring an expansive primary suite with separate seating area and encapsulating Gulf Views. The primary bathroom rivals a day at the spa, with an expansive contemporary walk-in shower and lavish dressing area. The third floor also features a private workspace with panoramic views of the Gulf’s crystalline waters, and a cozy bunk nook perfect for younger guests or extra sleeping accommodations. Additionally, this level includes a luxurious king guest suite with an ensuite bath, providing a serene and spacious retreat for visitors. For convenience there is also a secondary laundry room that features a coffee/wet bar. Beyond the main home, this estate caters to every need with additional thoughtfully designed structures. A three-car air-conditioned garage ensures secure and convenient storage for vehicles, golf carts, and beach essentials. The private carriage house king suite, nestled in the estate’s courtyard which is complete with covered seating, a grilling station and out fireplace. At the heart of the estate lies a remarkable indoor-outdoor entertainment pavilion. This space, complete with a full kitchen, living area, and dual glass roller doors, blurs the line between inside and out, creating an idyllic venue for gatherings. Adjacent to this pavilion is a stunning in-ground pool and sunning deck, offering a luxurious space to unwind under the Florida sun. This estate is not just a property, it’s a lifestyle, designed to elevate every moment and create memories that last a lifetime. LAYOUT FIRST FLOOR: • Grand Foyer with Spiral Staircase, Drop Chandelier & Glass Elevator • Media Room with entrance to Private Beach Walkover • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bathroom • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bathroom • Laundry Room with Front Load Washer & Dryer and Sink • Laundry Room doubles as a Wet/Coffee Bar (Sink, Mini Fridge, Coffee Maker, Microwave & Dishwasher • Full Bathroom with Single Vanity & Walk-in Tile/Glass Shower SECOND FLOOR: • Main Living Space with Accordion Doors Opening to Gulf Front Infinity Pool & Porch with Seating • Kitchen with large island that seats 4 • Kitchen Appliances include induction range, oven, convection microwave, toaster oven, espresso/coffee machine oversized fridge, & dual dishwashers + Butler's Pantry • Wet bar with Sink, Wine Fridge & Ice Machine • Secondary Seating Area • Dining Room Overlooking the Gulf (seats 8) • Library/Office Nook • Half Bathroom • North Facing Balcony with Summer Kitchen (Gas Grill, Power Burners & Sink) Seating & Dining Area THIRD FLOOR: • Primary King Suite with Ensuite Bathroom • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bathroom • Bunk Nook • Office • Laundry Room (Frontload Washer & Dryer) with Wet/Coffee Bar (Sink, Dishwasher, & Mini Fridge) CARRIAGE HOUSE: • King Guest Suite with Shared Bathroom • Carriage House opens to Courtyard with Outdoor Fireplace, Grill & Seating POOL HOUSE: • Media Area with Seating (Queen Sleeper Sofa) • Full Kitchen with Island (seats 4) • Space Complete Opens to Pool Deck Via Dual Glass Garage Doors OUTDOORS: • Gate Estate • Pool House Pool can be heated and has water features with outdoor dining and sun loungers. Pool is surrounded by lush landscaping and privacy fencing • Gulf Front Pool is an infinity edge pool surrounded by covered seating • Outdoor shower • Deeded Beach Access with Private Beach Walkover • Grassy Lawn overlooking dunes **Indoor Fireplaces not for guest use**
